newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Peugeot estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Peugeot estimates cut.

text.p: Earnings estimates for French carmaker Peugeot were cut at JP Morgan, the investment bank said on Monday.

In a research note, JP Morgan said competitive pressures in the European car industry were showing no signs of abating and could even be getting worse. It repeated a "market performer" rating on the stock.

For 1996 JP Morgan cut its estimates for net profit at Peugeot to 1,125 million francs from 1,514 million. It said there had been a collapse in demand in the fourth quarter of last year when a French government incentive scheme expired.
